_note: Realm 3's verb. Formations attack the tick economy rather than hit points -- which is the only thing that has ever answered a realm gap. See doc section 12.

binding_mesh.name: Binding Mesh
binding_mesh._magnitude_note: 0.9 nearly doubles what every enemy action costs them. It has to be this large to be a genuine counterweight -- it is the third realm's headline verb, it costs 34 qi and a turn of setup, and a timid version of it is decoration.
binding_mesh.line: You lay the mesh out in chalk and breath. The air inside it thickens like cooling sugar.
binding_mesh.description: Everything they do costs them half again as much time.

drawing_array.name: Drawing Array
drawing_array.line: You open the array and the room starts giving. It is not your qi. That is the whole point of the third realm.
drawing_array.description: Draws ambient world energy back into you each time you act.

sundering_line.name: Sundering Line
sundering_line.line: A single line of chalk, drawn between you and them, and then stepped over.
sundering_line.description: Strips most of what they were hiding behind.
